what_it_does: All-in-one workspace for docs, wikis, databases and project tracking.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 for public/OAuth integrations (access + refresh tokens); internal connection tokens and personal access tokens sent as Bearer. Internal connections require workspace owner and must be shared with each page.
access_notes: Integrations are created in the Developer portal by a workspace owner; no plan requirement stated in the auth docs. Free-plan API availability not explicitly confirmed on a page opened this session (inferred).
api_notes: Pages, databases/data sources, blocks, users, comments, search; JS SDK and Postman collection. Resource list not fully verified this session.

what_it_does: Spreadsheet-database hybrid for building no-code apps and workflows.
auth_notes: Personal access tokens or OAuth access tokens, both sent as Bearer; legacy api_key param not supported. Enterprise scopes need Enterprise Scale plan.
access_notes: Personal access tokens available on 'All plan types' including free. Per-plan API call limits exist but were not verified this session.
api_notes: Web API for bases, tables, records, fields, webhooks; enterprise endpoints gated by plan.

what_it_does: Issue tracking and project planning tool for software teams.
auth_notes: OAuth2 recommended for multi-user apps (Bearer); personal API keys for scripts, creatable by admins or permitted members, scopable to permissions/teams.
access_notes: Keys/OAuth apps created in workspace settings without approval. Docs opened do not state plan availability; free-plan API access is inferred.
api_notes: Single GraphQL API covering issues, projects, cycles, comments, documents, labels, users; webhooks for many entity types; TS SDK.

what_it_does: Atlassian issue and project tracking for software and business teams.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 (3LO) authorization code via app created in Atlassian developer console (recommended); Basic auth with email + API token for scripts. Forge/Connect apps use separate models.
access_notes: 3LO apps are self-serve in the developer console with no approval; sharing toggle enables distribution (unreviewed apps show a warning). Free Jira Cloud site for testing is inferred, not verified this session.
api_notes: Jira Cloud platform REST API v3 plus Software/Service Management APIs; hundreds of endpoints.

what_it_does: Work management platform for tasks, projects and team workflows.
auth_notes: OAuth for multi-user apps, personal access tokens (Bearer), OpenID Connect; Service Accounts are Enterprise-only and created by super admins.
access_notes: PAT/OAuth creation is self-serve, but Asana's help article lists API availability only for paid tiers (Starter, Advanced, Enterprise, etc.), not Free. Paid-plan trial likely needed; not fully confirmed.
api_notes: REST API for tasks, projects, portfolios, goals, sections, custom fields, users, webhooks, etc.

what_it_does: Work OS with boards for projects, CRM and team workflows.
auth_notes: Personal V2 API tokens in Authorization header; OAuth app tokens with extra permission scopes for marketplace/apps.
access_notes: Free developer account (up to 10 seats, 1,000 items, 10M API complexity) for building and testing API integrations.
api_notes: GraphQL API for boards, items, columns, updates, users, workspaces, docs; complexity-based limits.

what_it_does: Project management app for tasks, docs, goals and time tracking.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 authorization code (Bearer); personal API tokens (pk_ prefix, never expire). Only Workspace owners/admins can create OAuth apps.
access_notes: Public API available on all ClickUp plans including Free Forever; user/guest management endpoints are Enterprise-only.
api_notes: REST API v2 for workspaces, spaces, folders, lists, tasks, comments, time tracking, goals, webhooks.

what_it_does: Doc-and-table platform combining documents, spreadsheets and apps (now Superhuman Docs).
auth_notes: API tokens created in My account, sent as Bearer; can be restricted to docs/tables and read/write. No OAuth mentioned in API v1 docs.
access_notes: API is free in both free and paid workspaces; createDoc requires Doc Maker/Admin role.
api_notes: Docs, pages, tables, columns, rows (upsert/update/delete), formulas, controls, permissions; async mutations with status endpoint. Separate Admin API.

what_it_does: Spreadsheet-style work management for projects, sheets and reports.
auth_notes: API access tokens (Bearer) generated in UI; OAuth 2.0 three-legged flow for user consent. Smartsheet Gov and EU regions use separate tokens.
access_notes: API access tokens available on Business and Enterprise plans only. Free 'developer tools' registration (to register OAuth apps) requires a licensed Business-plan-or-higher user; no free developer sandbox found. Whether a free trial grants API tokens not verified.
api_notes: REST API 2.0 for sheets, rows, columns, attachments, reports, workspaces, users, webhooks.

what_it_does: Time tracking, expenses and invoicing for teams and freelancers.
auth_notes: Personal access tokens from Harvest ID Developers section, or OAuth2 (authorization code / implicit). Every request also needs Harvest-Account-Id header.
access_notes: 30-day free trial (no card) and a Free plan (1 seat, 2 projects) exist; API access per plan not stated in docs opened, so trial/free API access is inferred.
api_notes: REST/JSON v2: time entries, projects, tasks, clients, expenses, invoices, estimates, users, reports. 100 req/15s (reports 100/15min).
